# Vendored: safetyhook + Zydis (amalgamated)

- `safetyhook.hpp`, `safetyhook.cpp`: safetyhook v0.7.0 (https://github.com/cursey/safetyhook), Boost Software
  License 1.0, see `LICENSE`.
- `Zydis.h`, `Zydis.c`: Zydis disassembler and its Zycore support library (https://github.com/zyantific/zydis),
  amalgamated by safetyhook's `amalgamate.py`; MIT, see `LICENSE-Zydis` and `LICENSE-Zycore`.

Do not edit these files; update them by replacing them from a new safetyhook release.
